name: rpg-mcp
description: A persistent, rules-aware RPG engine (SRD 5.2.1) that turns your AI into a game master for campaigns that last for years.
long_description: The AI improvises the fiction; the engine owns the truth. Characters, HP, money, XP, inventory, time, party, relationships, events and checkpoints live in one local SQLite file, so a campaign can run across many conversations without any chat transcript. Rules content from the SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0) is embedded and imported on first run: no network access, no account. After installing, tell Claude to read the guide resource and start a campaign.

data_dir.title: Campaign data directory
data_dir.description: Where campaigns are stored (a single SQLite file, rpg.db). Back up this directory and your campaigns are safe. A leading ~ means your home directory.
